description: The block search_pool shows the model for one measure: a heading, the description, an optional sources line naming the data sources the measure takes, and the model-visible arguments with their type, requiredness, and description. Both packages must emit the same bytes, because this text is part of what the agent reads. Each case builds a measure from `measure` and renders it with `source_names`; `heading` overrides the default heading when present.

cases.name: a measure without arguments renders heading and description only
arguments render with type, requiredness, and description
cases.expected:
### order_count
Count of orders.

arguments:
  - region (one of {EMEA, AMER}, required) The sales region.
  - revenue_under (number, optional) Cap.

cases.name: the sources line names only injected arguments that match a source
cases.expected:
### region_revenue
Total revenue for a region.

sources: warehouse
arguments:
  - region (string, required) The sales region.

cases.name: no sources line when the agent has a single unnamed source
cases.expected:
### region_revenue
Total revenue for a region.

arguments:
  - region (string, required) The sales region.

cases.name: a string array names its item type
cases.expected:
### tagged_orders
Orders by tag.

arguments:
  - tags (array of {string}, required) Tags to match.

cases.name: an enum array lists its vocabulary
cases.expected:
### regional_orders
Orders by region.

arguments:
  - regions (array of {EMEA, AMER}, optional) Regions to include.

cases.name: integer and boolean arguments name their type
cases.expected:
### recent_orders
Recent orders.

arguments:
  - days (integer, required) How many days back.
  - include_cancelled (boolean, optional) Include cancelled orders.

cases.name: an explicit heading replaces the measure name
cases.heading: order_count (measure)

cases.name: an explicit empty heading is rendered verbatim, not treated as absent
